GoF Design Patterns Legend

 Factory Method (Creational) — Creates Memberships & Loyalty Cards
 Facade (Structural) — Unified entry point orchestrating booking workflow
 Decorator (Structural) — Dynamically attaches extra booking services & fees
 Strategy (Behavioural) — Calculates final price & bonuses by loyalty tier
 Observer (Behavioural) — Dispatches alerts, reminders & bonus accruals
 Core Domain & Services — Business entities, catalog & admin services
